plan.purpose: Check supported swapchain statistics for moving-gameplay display observations without renderer hooks or another ETW search.
plan.first_probe: Log GetLastPresentCount and GetFrameStatistics after Present. No DwmFlush or extra synchronization.
plan.second_probe: Only if the first returns stale/zero statistics, try explicitly labeled DwmFlush synchronization to test the documented hardware-flip-queue caveat. This changes scheduling and cannot inherit baseline performance claims.
plan.mapping: Map the returned PresentCount to a recorded successful GetLastPresentCount. Associate PresentRefreshCount with an observed SyncRefreshCount/SyncQPCTime anchor; exact anchor matches are preferred. Do not assume Present call count equals displayed frames, treat duplicate statistics as new frames, or label a refresh estimate as physical latency.
plan.failure: Stop if results remain unsupported, zero or unmappable after the declared probes. Keep all HRESULTs, counters, source hashes and the working non-probe binary.
plan.limits: Microsoft cautions that statistics can be unreliable with multiple monitors or other fullscreen applications. No physical input, scanout, panel-response or neural fidelity acceptance. Hardware/GPU processing remain unchanged.

window.alignment: Interpolation of game log simulation timestamps; local clock mapped to QPC at launch. Millisecond log precision; not input-to-photon.

scope: Diagnostic OS swapchain queries alongside actual 1440p gameplay. No displayed FPS or latency can be calculated from zero display counters. DwmFlush changes scheduling; do not treat its cadence as the normal companion.
explanation: Both probes returned one initial DXGI_ERROR_FRAME_STATISTICS_DISJOINT followed by S_OK with all display counters zero. GetLastPresentCount advanced, proving submitted calls only. DwmFlush did not make the counters usable. Stop this route after the two declared probes; keep the earlier separate PresentMon display evidence and label moving-path display latency unavailable.
download_change: None. Optional diagnostic flags are off by default; the previously verified package remains unchanged.

native_parity.scope: Independent pretrained CPU reference against native D3D11 curve network; not application latency or image quality. Presentation shader text is also unchanged.
